narrative.headline: Discover Japan overnight spots with Japanese coverage, honest facility evidence and booking links.
narrative.value_prop: Search designated overnight spots using the fuller Japanese source, compare facilities and parking-space dimensions, and preserve unknowns. Dated results are provider-filtered candidates; complete quotes and availability require provider confirmation.
narrative.auth_narrative: Public discovery needs no credentials. Complete bookings in Carstay’s canonical website flow.

quickstart.comment: Check the command without credentials or network.
Evaluate explicit constraints, preserving unknown acceptance.

troubleshoots.fix: Use --lang ja and spots coverage to inspect publication gaps.

troubleshoots.symptom: Facility false flag has a fee or access note
troubleshoots.fix: Read spots show or spots audit and confirm the qualified evidence with the provider.

narrative.when_to_use: Use for Carstay Japan designated overnight spots, itinerary-coordinate candidates, explicit parking-space and facility evidence, Japanese coverage, and canonical booking handoff.
anti_triggers: Guaranteed vacancy, dated total quotes or certification that any vehicle is accepted.
Road routing, drive time or automatic translation.

recipes.explanation: Distance is straight-line kilometers, not driving distance.

recipes.explanation: Keep only decision fields in agent output.

recipes.explanation: Check missing or qualified evidence without claiming vacancy.
